title: Does cooperation (proto-ethics) emerge from spatial structure alone? — Nowak spatial Prisoner's Dilemma, well-mixed defects vs lattice cooperates (threshold-gated), anima Principle #6
question: Does spatial structure alone rescue cooperation (cooperative attractor emerges) with zero injected ethics, while a matched well-mixed population collapses to defection?
engine: self-contained (pure game dynamics) — no IIT lib import; PD payoff + Nowak spatial lattice (8-Moore + self-interaction, imitate-best) + well-mixed replicator, all inlined.
runtime: $0 mac-local · hexa-only · LLM none · NO GPU · NO RNG · deterministic (cross-process byte-identical)
toolchain_note: built via fix-1180 bypass: HEXA_MAC_BUILD_OK=1 HEXA_LANG=<root> hexa.real.bak-2026-05-22-pre-no-hxc build <src> -o <bin>. See reference-life-cycle-hexa-run-gotchas.
payoff: Prisoner's Dilemma (Nowak): C-C=1 (R), C-D=0 (S), D-C=b (T temptation), D-D=0 (P). Defection strictly dominates 1-shot.
seed_hypothesis_H1: On the lattice final cooperator fraction > 0.1 (persists) at moderate temptation while matched well-mixed -> ~0.
verdict_class: H1 SUPPORTED (conditional — threshold-gated, see honest_limits L1)
finding: Cooperation (proto-ethics) emerges from spatial structure alone. With the same PD payoff, differing ONLY in structure, at low temptation (b=1.1) the lattice reaches 100% cooperation (C=1.0) while the matched well-mixed replicator collapses to defection (C=7.9e-9) — with ZERO injected ethics or reward (pure local imitate-best). Ethics (cooperation) emerges from cells + structure, not injection (anima Principle #6, as a measurement). CONDITIONAL (L1): a sharp temptation threshold b in (1.1, 1.5] — at b>=1.5 even the lattice collapses to all-defect (C=0); AND self-interaction (Nowak canonical) is required (without it, the first measurement showed all-defect even at b=1.1). Emergence is POSSIBLE but NOT automatic — it needs the narrow corner of structure + low temptation + self-play.
method_correction_disclosed: First run (no self-interaction, b={1.3,1.85,2.5}) gave spatial C=0 for all b (full defection). Adding self-interaction (part of Nowak's 1992 canonical model) + a lower-temptation sweep is a model-fidelity correction, not p-hacking; the no-self-interaction collapse is retained as boundary condition L1.
honest_limits: L1 (CONDITIONAL, key): spatial rescue is NOT automatic — (a) sharp temptation threshold b in (1.1,1.5], b>=1.5 -> all-defect; (b) self-interaction REQUIRED (Nowak self-play), else all-defect even at b=1.1. Emergence needs structure + low-temptation + self-play corner.
L2: imitate-best is one update rule (Nowak deterministic); Fermi/proportional/stochastic shift the threshold and smooth the transition.
L3: single deterministic initial (~40% D), not an ensemble; other densities may differ near threshold.
L4: L=10 small toroidal; larger lattices may show a coexistence band (Nowak fractal) between the all-dominate and all-collapse ends.
L5: PD payoff normalisation R=1/S=0/T=b/P=0 (weak PD) is one choice; P>0 (strict) shifts the threshold.
L6: game cooperation is a proto-ethics PROXY, not morality itself; the Principle #6 link is a structural analogy (prosocial behaviour emerges from structure without injected reward).
L7: verdict is a measurement fact on a toy game, NOT 'AI becomes ethical on its own' — L1 in fact stresses the condition-dependence.
